Name: Greater Chicago Food Depository
Description: The Greater Chicago Food Depository strives to end hunger by connecting neighbors with healthy food and advancing solutions that address the root causes of hunger. They supply donated and purchased food to a network of 650+ pantries, soup kitchens, and shelters across Cook County. They also invest in programs and services to lift neighbors out of poverty and into a secure and healthy future.

Name: Cara Collective
Description: Cara Collective is dedicated to developing employment pathways and individual and community success. Their mission is to build an inclusive economy by unlocking the strengths of people experiencing homelessness and poverty, helping them find gainful employment. Name: Chicago Public Library Foundation
Description: The Chicago Public Library Foundation accelerates the potential of the public library by investing in resources that transform lives and communities. They fund programs not covered by tax dollars to expand access, advance learning, and connect communities in every neighborhood. Their goal is to close the academic opportunity gap and bring tools for success to all Chicagoans.

Name: Alliance for the Great Lakes
Description: The Alliance for the Great Lakes is a nonpartisan nonprofit working across the region to protect the fresh, clean, and natural waters of the Great Lakes. Their work spans legislative action, community engagement, and K–12 education.
Tags: Great Lakes, water protection, environmental advocacy, conservation, pollution, education, research, community

Description: Center on Halsted is the Midwest's most comprehensive community center dedicated to advancing the health, wellness, and cultural enrichment of Chicago's LGBTQ+ community. Since 1973, it has provided a vast array of programs and services — from behavioral health to senior care — fostering connection and purpose for tens of thousands annually. Name: The Night Ministry
Description: The Night Ministry is a Chicago-based organization whose mission is to provide human connection, housing support, and health care to members of the community who are unhoused or experiencing poverty.
